answer: Proof-of-stake protocols enforce Sybil resistance by tethering voting power to locked capital rather than ephemeral identity. An agent must hold an onyx asset to validate, making the cost of spinning up fake nodes linearly prohibitive. Each identity acts as a cipher for its bonded weight, while the network’s consensus functions as a lantern, illuminating malicious behavior and enabling slashing, which imposes a direct financial penalty on any adversary attempting to flood the ecosystem.
